title: ElderBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents for Older Adults

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating mobile GUI agents and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on ElderBench, a benchmark comprising naturally elicited smartphone task instructions from older adults, to measure performance degradation and accessibility barriers compared to standard instructions.

Conducting controlled instruction normalization by rewriting elderly-specific language patterns (such as indirect speech, referential ambiguity, and under-specification) into standard, action-oriented variants to isolate and quantify the failure rates caused by linguistic mismatches.
